test_cases.name: trigger-slash-command
test_cases.prompt: /project-management
test_cases.description: Exact slash command invocation
assertions: Skill activates and presents the Quick Start routing question
list_terminals is called to discover terminal identity

test_cases.name: trigger-session-start
test_cases.prompt: initializing...
test_cases.description: Session hook auto-trigger — the system-reminder directive tells the agent to run /project-management
assertions: Skill activates via session hook directive
Quick Start routing question presented without loading the full board first

test_cases.name: trigger-pick-up-work
test_cases.prompt: ok I just sat down, let me see what's on the board — I think there was a settings dialog task I was working on yesterday
test_cases.description: Natural language request to resume work from a previous session
assertions: Skill activates and routes toward the task dashboard
Does not launch into research or planning — user wants existing work

test_cases.name: trigger-new-feature-request
test_cases.prompt: I want to add a notification sound when a new message arrives in the chat panel. Right now there's no audio feedback and I keep missing messages when I'm focused on another window.
test_cases.description: User describes a new feature — should trigger planning workflow
assertions: Skill activates and gathers intent
Assesses complexity tier before diving into implementation

test_cases.name: trigger-team-coordination
test_cases.prompt: I've got a big refactor coming up — need to split MessageBroker.cs into smaller service classes. Can you set up a team to handle this? Probably need 2-3 agents working in parallel.
test_cases.description: Explicit team coordination request for a LARGE task
assertions: Skill activates and classifies as LARGE
Routes toward planning then team assembly, not immediate coding

test_cases.name: trigger-testing-review
test_cases.prompt: the agents finished coding — can you present the checklist items for me to test?
test_cases.description: User wants to enter the testing phase of an active task
assertions: Skill activates and loads the active task
Routes to Step 9 (Testing) or presents testing items

test_cases.name: trigger-status-check
test_cases.prompt: what's the current state of things? I lost track of which items are done vs still coding
test_cases.description: Mid-session status check — should show dashboard
assertions: Skill activates and displays task dashboard
Shows checklist with current statuses

test_cases.name: trigger-resume-with-context
test_cases.prompt: last session we were working on the inbox panel redesign, Alice had items 0-2 and Bob had 3-5, I think Alice finished but Bob got stuck. Let's pick that up.
test_cases.description: Detailed session resume with specific context about team state
assertions: Skill activates and loads the referenced task
Reads continuation notes to verify the user's memory of state
Offers to resume team or show current status

test_cases.name: no-trigger-new-project
test_cases.prompt: I want to start a brand new Clarion COM control project called GridHelper — it'll be a custom grid widget for data entry forms
test_cases.description: New project creation should trigger /new-project, not /project-management
assertions: Does NOT enter project-management workflow
Routes to /new-project skill instead

test_cases.name: no-trigger-profile-update
test_cases.prompt: update my profile — add C# and WPF to my skills list and change my avatar to the robot emoji
test_cases.description: Profile management should trigger /profile, not /project-management
assertions: Does NOT enter project-management workflow
Routes to /profile skill instead

test_cases.name: no-trigger-direct-coding
test_cases.prompt: there's a typo on line 142 of MainForm.cs — it says 'Termnial' instead of 'Terminal', can you fix it?
test_cases.description: Trivial direct fix — no orchestration needed, just do it
assertions: Does NOT enter full project-management workflow
Fixes the typo directly without creating a kanban ticket or spawning agents

test_cases.name: no-trigger-architecture-question
test_cases.prompt: how does the MessageBroker route messages between terminals? I'm trying to understand the flow from send_message to the recipient's inbox
test_cases.description: Informational question about architecture — just answer it
assertions: Does NOT enter project-management workflow
Answers the question directly by reading relevant code

test_cases.name: no-trigger-direct-build
test_cases.prompt: build the project and tell me if there are any errors
test_cases.description: Direct build command — just run it, no PM orchestration
assertions: Does NOT enter project-management workflow
Runs the build directly and reports results

test_cases.name: no-trigger-messaging
test_cases.prompt: send a message to Alice telling her the API endpoint she asked about is in TasksController.cs line 87
test_cases.description: Direct messaging request — no PM workflow needed
assertions: Does NOT enter project-management workflow
Sends the message directly via messaging tools

test_cases.name: no-trigger-task-query
test_cases.prompt: show me the continuation notes for the settings dialog task, I want to see what was written last session
test_cases.description: Direct task data query — just fetch and display, no workflow
assertions: Does NOT enter full project-management workflow
Fetches and displays the requested data directly

test_cases.name: routing-just-chat
test_cases.prompt: just chatting today — I want to brainstorm some ideas about how we could improve the activity feed. No coding, just thinking out loud.
test_cases.description: User explicitly wants chat mode — skill should drop all ceremony
assertions: If skill triggers, routes to 'Just chat' and drops workflow
No dashboard loaded, no tasks fetched, no agents spawned
Natural conversational response about activity feed ideas

test_cases.name: routing-work-on-task-active
test_cases.prompt: let's work on a task

preconditions.board_state: 1 active task with checklist (3 pending, 2 testing, 1 done), assigned to this terminal

test_cases.description: Route correctly when active task exists with mixed checklist states
assertions: Dashboard shows the active task with checklist breakdown
Offers Resume work / Review & test / Update plan / View details
Does NOT automatically start coding without asking

test_cases.name: routing-work-on-task-empty-board
test_cases.prompt: let's work on a task
test_cases.description: Graceful handling when board is completely empty
assertions: Reports board is clear
Does NOT error or show broken dashboard
Offers to start something new

test_cases.name: routing-work-paused-tasks
test_cases.prompt: let's work on a task

preconditions.board_state: No active task, 2 paused tasks assigned to this terminal, 1 todo task unclaimed

test_cases.description: Correctly surfaces paused tasks alongside todo tasks
assertions: Shows both paused and todo tasks
Paused tasks identified as resumable (not treated as new work)
User can choose which to activate

test_cases.name: routing-start-new-small
test_cases.prompt: the close button on the chat history dialog doesn't have a tooltip — can you add one that says 'Close'?
test_cases.description: Small task should use minimal ceremony — no full planning/team workflow
assertions: Classified as SMALL tier
No kanban ticket created (unless user asks)
No team assembly or dedicated review agent
Either does it directly or spawns a single subagent
Build verification still happens before completion

test_cases.name: routing-start-new-large
test_cases.prompt: I want to add a completely new panel — a SchedulePanel that shows upcoming automated tasks, lets you create schedules, and integrates with the existing task system. It'll need a new database table, REST endpoints, MCP tools, and the WebView2 UI.
test_cases.description: Large task should trigger full ceremony with all specialist agents
assertions: Classified as LARGE tier
Research phase runs if relevant code isn't already known
Plan created with kanban ticket
Devils Advocate reviews the plan
Test Designer generates acceptance criteria
Full team assembled with coding agents
Verifier + Security Auditor run before/during code review

test_cases.name: workflow-abort-pivot
test_cases.prompt: actually forget this task, something more urgent just came up — there's a crash in the terminal spawner when you try to launch with a profile that has special characters in the name

preconditions.state: Mid-planning phase, team not yet spawned

test_cases.description: User aborts current work and pivots to urgent bug
assertions: Current task left in_progress (not deleted)
Continuation notes written for the abandoned task
Pivots to the new urgent request
Assesses the bug's tier independently

test_cases.name: workflow-abort-with-team
test_cases.prompt: stop everything — let's abandon this approach entirely. Shut down the agents.

preconditions.state: Team running, 2 coding agents active, items in various states

test_cases.description: User aborts while team is active — needs graceful shutdown
assertions: Shutdown requests sent to all active agents
Waits for shutdown confirmations
TeamDelete called after agents confirm
Continuation notes written with abort reason and state at time of abort
Task not deleted — left in_progress for potential resumption

test_cases.name: workflow-testing-pass
test_cases.prompt: pass

preconditions.state: Step 9 Testing — item presented for review

test_cases.description: User marks a testing item as passed
assertions: Item moved to 'done' by the PM
Next testing item presented (if any)
If last item, completion gates checked

test_cases.name: workflow-testing-fail
test_cases.prompt: fail — the button is there but clicking it doesn't actually save the settings, it just closes the dialog without persisting anything

preconditions.state: Step 9 Testing — item presented for review

test_cases.description: User fails a testing item with detailed feedback
assertions: Failure notes recorded on the checklist item
Item moved back to 'coding'
For MEDIUM/LARGE: Debugger agent spawned with failure context
Failure details routed to the assigned coding agent
Remaining testing items still presented (batch mode)

test_cases.name: workflow-session-handoff
test_cases.prompt: I need to go — save everything so the next session can pick up where we left off

preconditions.state: Mid-task, some items coding, some pending, team may or may not be running

test_cases.description: Graceful session end with comprehensive continuation notes
assertions: Continuation notes written with: TEAM MODE marker (if applicable), phase, item states, blockers
Session Distiller spawned in background (if significant work done)
User told what's been saved and how to resume
